ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
(function(){
var h=String(result==null?'':result);
var re=/property="(og[^"]*)"\s+content="([^"]*)"/g,mm,ogm={};
while((mm=re.exec(h))!==null){if(!ogm[mm[1]])ogm[mm[1]]=mm[2]}
function og(k){return ogm['og:novel:'+k]||ogm['og:'+k]||''}
var name=og('book_name'),author=og('author'),cat=og('category'),st=og('status');
var upd=og('update_time'),last=og('latest_chapter_name'),intro=og('description');
var cover=ogm['og:image']||'';
try{
 source.put('hjName',name);source.put('hjAuthor',author);source.put('hjCover',cover);
 source.put('hjIntro',intro);source.put('hjUpd',upd);source.put('hjLast',last);
 source.put('hjKind',cat);source.put('hjStatus',st);
}catch(e0){}
return JSON.stringify({'name':name,'author':author,'kind':cat+(st?'·'+st:''),'coverUrl':cover,'lastChapter':last});
})()
</js>

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
(function(){
var S=function(x){try{return String(x==null?'':x)}catch(e){return ''}};
var h=S(result);
var chal=h.indexOf('__sc_clearance')>=0||h.indexOf('正在检查您的浏览器')>=0;
if(chal){
 try{cookie.setCookie(baseUrl,'__sc_clearance=1')}catch(e0){}
 var h2=S(java.ajax(baseUrl));
 if(h2!=='')h=h2;
}
var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(h,'https://www.huangjinwu.org/');
var es=doc.select('a.book-card[href^=/novel]');
var out=[],seen={};
for(var i=0;i<es.size();i++){
 var e=es.get(i);
 var u=S(e.attr('abs:href'));
 if(!u||seen[u])continue;
 seen[u]=1;
 var t=S(e.select('.book-title').first()==null?'':e.select('.book-title').first().text());
 var au=S(e.select('.book-author').first()==null?'':e.select('.book-author').first().text()).replace(/^\s*作者：/,'').trim();
 var d=S(e.select('.book-desc').first()==null?'':e.select('.book-desc').first().text());
 var ki='',ws='';
 var ms=e.select('.book-badge');
 for(var k=0;k<ms.size();k++){
 var v=S(ms.get(k).text());
 var cls=S(ms.get(k).attr('class'));
 if(cls.indexOf('category')>=0)ki=v;
 else if(cls.indexOf('status')>=0)ki=(ki?ki+'·':'')+v;
 else if(cls.indexOf('words')>=0)ws=v;
 }
 if(ws)ki+=(ki?'·':'')+ws;
 var n='',p='0';
 var mn=/(\d+)\D*$/.exec(u);
 if(mn){n=mn[1];p=n.length>3?n.slice(0,-3):'0'}
 var cv=HJ_B+'/book/files/article/image/'+p+'/'+n+'/'+n+'s.jpg';
 out.push(JSON.stringify({'name':t,'author':au,'kind':ki,'intro':d,'coverUrl':cv,'url':u}));
}
if(out.length===0){try{java.toast('黄金屋搜索0条:len='+h.length+' chal='+chal+' card='+(h.indexOf('book-card')>=0))}catch(e){}}
return out;
})()
</js>
